work.name: DSTax Technologies
work.summary: Technical lead and lead developer for a tax-integration platform, coordinating development projects and supporting client implementations.

Led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the tax-integration platform, broadening tax-provider and financial-platform support and improving UI/UX.
Optimized asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput.
Migrated production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS.
Managed internal development projects and client-coordinated work, sharing integration updates, reporting status, and responding to questions and requests.
Supported end-to-end integration implementations, including requirements gathering, setup, troubleshooting, and go-live support.
Created and maintained client guides and knowledge-base articles.

work.name: Colectivo Coffee Roasters
highlights: Partnered with the IT department to install and troubleshoot new point-of-sale nodes.
Fulfilled orders for more than 1000 restaurant and store clients.

work.name: Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global)

Initiated web automations that reduced manual database-maintenance work.
Managed SharePoint sites and data and designed data-input forms to improve accessibility, reduce errors, and promote cross-department information sharing.

coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Team,
I am applying for the Lead AI Engineer position at Reyes. My background combines software development, business-system integration, project coordination, and client implementation support. At DSTax Technologies, I serve as a technical lead and lead developer for a tax-integration platform. The role’s focus on connecting applications with enterprise data and operational workflows aligns with my experience translating business requirements into working integrations. I would bring that software delivery background to Reyes while recognizing that the position also calls for specialized production AI experience beyond what my record currently demonstrates.

At DSTax Technologies, I led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the tax-integration platform, broadening support for tax providers and financial platforms and improving UI/UX. My work also included optimizing asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput and migrating production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS. These responsibilities provide a practical foundation for the integration, performance, and cloud delivery aspects of the position. In a second example, at Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global), I evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that made facility information available to employees and customers. I also initiated web automations that reduced manual database-maintenance work and managed SharePoint sites and data, including forms designed to improve accessibility and reduce errors. That work connects directly with the operational information needs underlying Reyes’s proposed AI applications.

I welcome the opportunity to discuss how this experience could contribute to Reyes’s Lead AI Engineer role. Its emphasis on applications that retrieve business information and support operational actions offers a clear connection to the integration and workflow problems I have worked on. Thank you for considering my application and the engineering foundation I would bring to your team.
Sincerely,
Kyle M. Anderson
reviewNotes: Emphasizes technical leadership, business-system integrations, AWS migration, asynchronous performance, and operational automation. The master does not establish the required three years of production AI/ML implementation, agent frameworks, RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases, ML frameworks, AI mentoring, or enterprise-scale architecture design. It also does not document Microsoft Graph API, Snowflake, infrastructure automation, or the preferred Azure and data-platform technologies. Listed AI tools do not establish production AI engineering experience.
